name: Web pages accessibility benchmark
description: A benchmark collection and test suite for evaluating automated tools' ability to detect accessibility issues across web pages.
reputation: An early benchmark/toolset in web accessibility research; historically referenced but superseded in parts by newer standards and datasets.
notes: Older dataset from 2003 — web technologies and accessibility guidelines have evolved (WCAG changes), so labels/coverage may be outdated; limited size and scope; not an LLM benchmark.
